Nina (Docs): opened a PR updating the versioned SDK examples and migration notes; need a merge before the docs cutoff Tue 18:00 UTC. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/4612

Victor (Eng): Which examples changed? Any deprecated calls still in there?

Nina (Docs): Auth flow and responses examples. Replaced `client.create` with `client.responses.create`. Also mention the feature-flag `responses-v2` in the migration note.

Sam (Product): If the sample references the flag we should merge behind `draft: true` or `unpublished` so it doesn't show on the live site until the flag flips.

Lina (Release): Reminder: docs cutoff is Tue 18:00 UTC. If CI is green and approvals are present we can use the Wed 10:00 UTC merge slot; otherwise it waits for next cycle.

CI-bot: preview started for PR #4612 (job id pb-9921)

Victor (Eng): Snippet lint failing for `client.create`. I'll PR a quick patch to update snippets to the new shape.

Nina (Docs): Patch received and pushed. Added frontmatter `supported_sdk: ["1.4+"]` and set `draft: true` per product request.

CI-bot: preview build pb-9921  lint passed, linkcheck passed, preview: https://docs-preview/internal/4612

Sam (Product): Quick review done. Removed the public perf table and kept internal metrics in frontmatter. One minor wording nit; Nina will patch.

Victor (Eng): LGTM. Approving.

Nina (Docs): Wording nit fixed and pushed. All required approvals present.

Lina (Release): Added `merge-on-slot` label and scheduled Wed 10:00 UTC. Release notes set to internal-only for now.

Nina (Docs): Queued for Wed 10:00 UTC merge. Will not flip `draft` until Product confirms flag rollout. Will post update when merged. :thumbsup:

CI-bot: PR #4612 status: approvals=2, checks=passed, labels=[merge-on-slot,draft-ready]

Nina (Docs): Merged to main at 2025-02-12T10:00:03Z behind `draft: true`. Page is in the repo but excluded from the site. Closing thread.
